scope: Every own-turn prefix may STOP before end-turn effects. Candidates are board/resource endpoints, not mutually selectable deterministic plans or state reachability probabilities. Use conditional expansion for all legal choices and exact chance outcomes after observation.

selection.rule: Among complete equal-output methods, lowest sum of per-case median compute time; overlapping aggregate ranges are uncertain.
selection.correctness_status: Cross-method agreement only; independent oracle evidence required before recommendation.
